propositions: The tutorial currently instructs users to download the Gerrit hook directly via curl, which violates current project policy requiring make hooks
The tutorial permits small patches to bypass Gerrit review, contradicting the requirement that every change to main passes through Gerrit
The tutorial recommends recheck for suspected flaky failures without root-cause investigation, instead of directing users to the rebar-debug workflow
Documentation must be updated to enforce make hooks, mandatory Gerrit passage, sponsorship without bypass, environmental-only recheck usage, and nondeterministic test debugging via rebar-debug
Test suite must assert positive compliance with updated guidance and reject legacy instructions involving direct curl download, Gerrit bypass, and unsubstantiated recheck usage
